release_notes_summary: Calculator Show Work/Formulas parity and standard Searle equation.
notes: Adds Searle Standard / Takeoff Angle with distance and angle inputs, a blank-field friction default of 0.66, and complete formula substitutions.
Restores Show Work / Formulas content across calculators and workflows, including the original Pedestrian Throw Workflow.
Corrects Angled Momentum input-unit conversion and ignition-date handling; clears stale calculation work when inputs change.
Preserves the existing range method and displays its documented limitations separately from standard Searle.

Stable Windows x64 portable release. Use Check for Updates and Download Update; close the application before manually replacing or staging the portable folder. Automatic installation remains disabled in the existing updater.
Approved source base: 20fc45ea5032edb59ec86dba5495ba1694e8cdb5 plus the tested working-tree changes.
Repackaged from the tested local 0.9.4 snapshot; only build metadata and the bundled update-feed configuration changed. Calculator and updater code remain unchanged.

Calculator review evidence: 223 scenarios across 77 executable pages; final focused suite 308 passed, plus 7 focused momentum workflow checks. Six previously known unrelated source-suite failures remain documented.

Native Searle, pedestrian workflow, momentum V2, angled momentum, centroid, and ignition checks passed on the approved package. Stable packaging and update-path verification are recorded in the private release qualification report.
